subject: Recap & next steps: ClearClinic admin event export / compliance scope
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Recap & next steps: ClearClinic admin event export / compliance scope

Hi Susan — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth on scope and deliverables.

Summary of what you shared:
- ClearClinic requires immutable admin & API activity records for audits (HIPAA + internal policy) — retention target 7 years.
- SOC 2 Type II is in scope for your vendors; you asked for our attestation and evidence around admin activity exports.
- Need an automated export path to your secure bucket (SFTP or customer-managed S3) with signed manifests and per-file checksums.
- Required event types: admin logins, role changes, API key creation/rotation, model deployments, policy changes, data access events.

What Redwood can provide (high-level):
- API and admin-event stream with structured JSON lines (events include actor, timestamp, resource, action, request_id).
- Export tooling: scheduled bulk exports (daily), on-demand exports, and a continuous stream option to push to a customer endpoint.
- Immutability options: signed manifests + write-once object storage recommendations; we can also provide a verifiable hash chain for exported bundles.
- SOC 2 Type II report and control mappings (we will share the attestation + control matrix).

Open questions from our end (please confirm where possible):
1) Is SFTP to your environment preferred, or would you like to provide a customer-managed S3 bucket ARN?
2) Do you require signed, timestamped manifests (we support both SHA-256 + optional digital signatures)?
3) Are there specific export formats you prefer (NDJSON, CSV, Parquet)?
4) Any regulatory constraints on retention enforcement we should be aware of beyond the 7-year target?

Attachments: redwood-admin-export-overview.pdf (high-level format + sample fields).

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- You: send the vendor security questionnaire and confirm preferred delivery mechanism (SFTP vs S3).
- Redwood: share SOC 2 Type II report + export sample (we can provide a sanitized sample within 48 business hours).
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with your security/infra team; suggested slots Tue/Wed next week.

If that all looks right I’ll coordinate the follow-ups and loop in Priya (security) for the deep dive.

Best,
Tessa

Thanks Tessa — this is helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications and a doc attached.

Clarifications / asks:
- We prefer SFTP into our network for initial onboarding. Long term we may move to a customer-managed S3 bucket (we can provide an ARN later).
- Signed manifests are required. We need tamper-evidence for both file contents and file sequence.
- Format: NDJSON is preferred (one JSON event per line) but we can accept CSV for simpler ingest pipelines.
- Retention: 7 years, but searchable indexes for 2 years (hot) and archival for the remaining 5.
- We need admin events with raw request IDs and full actor context (IP, user-agent, auth method).

Attached: clearclinic-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf — please have your security/engineering team fill out the relevant sections and return.

Also: please provide a sanitized export sample (just one day's bundle) and your SOC 2 Type II attestation (or the SOC letter) for our vendor team.

On the deep-dive: Tue 24 Feb at 10:00 AM ET works for our infra lead (Ben O.) — can you confirm?

Best,
Susan Ramirez

Susan — confirmed for Tue 24 Feb 10:00 AM ET (inv sent).

Quick addendum from our security team on the export mechanics (sanitized summary):
- Delivery options: push via SFTP (FTPS recommended) or pull via customer-managed S3 with pre-signed URLs.
- Export bundle layout: daily_bundle_<YYYYMMDD>.tar.gz containing:
  - events_<YYYYMMDD>.ndjson (NDJSON, newline-delimited JSON events)
  - manifest_<YYYYMMDD>.json (per-file checksums + event counts + first/last ts)
  - signature_<YYYYMMDD>.sig (ECDSA signature of manifest)
- Immutability approach: Redwood signs manifests with our key; customer writes bundles into their write-once storage. For customers unable to enforce WORM on day 0, we can also mirror bundles into a hardened, append-only vault controlled by Redwood for the initial onboarding period.

Attached I’ve uploaded a sanitized sample export for your review: export-sample-2026-02.csv (note: sample format shows a flattened NDJSON -> CSV conversion for ease of ingest). Full NDJSON sample and SOC 2 attestation will be provided via secure link after the call.

Next steps (recap):
- Today/Tue 24 Feb 10:00 AM ET: technical deep-dive (Ben O., Priya, Tessa, Karthik).
- Fri 26 Feb EOD: Redwood to push sanitized NDJSON sample + SOC 2 artifact to secure link.
- Week of 3/8: pilot export to your SFTP endpoint.

If anything in the timeline needs to shift, let me know and we’ll update the mutual action plan.

Thanks — talk soon.
Tessa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
